Header: Blumeria graminis f.sp. tritici Powdery mildew, 小麦白粉病 in Chinese

Prevention: In case of infection, clean up crop residue to prevent overwintering of mildew.
In case no major pests or diseases, leave residues in the field to improve soils.
Plant non-dense, for example 225 plants/m 2 because dense vegetation may be conductive for spread of disease
Monitoring: Powdery mildew is a fungus that occurs on leaves, stems, even heads.
February from wheat heading period until pustulation period.
Choose 10 random points in the field.
At every point investigate 3 to 5 plants.
At early infestation, tiny white spots (1-2mm) are scattered across the leaves.
The small spots will get larger and denser.
The spots are on the upper side of the leaves.
The mildew may spread up and down the length of the plant.
Consider action when early first white spots occur on 5-15% of all plants.
Later, the spots become light brown, with some tiny black soluble dots on the spots.
Be careful, many tiny orange dots and spots are not mildew, they are rust fungi.
Direct Control: Bacillus subtilis (枯 草芽孢杆 菌).

Spray suspension on the leaves uniformly in the early period of powdery mildew.
But check product labels as each product may differ.
Remove the infected leaves or plants, if few.
Restrictions: When using a chemical or botanical pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.

Fenpropimorph- products (for example: enpropimorph 丁苯吗 啉).
Usually applied at 750g/1000l dilution per ha, but double-check product labels.
Spray in the early stage of disease.
Not toxic to bees or water.
Having sprayed, the effect will continue 3~4 weeks.
Pre- harvest interval (PHI) 2 weeks; restricted re-entry interval (REI) 1 day
Triadimefon- products (for example 粉 锈宁 15% triadimefon wettable powder).
Usually applied at 8.75g-15g (35-60g miscible oil) /75-100L water , but double-check product labels.
Spray in the early stage of disease when first early symptoms are seen.
